subject: Assurance handoff: renewal evidence sprint + dedicated capacity plan
messages:
From: Javier Morales <javier.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention change request

Hi Kimberly,

We’re kicking off the renewal cycle for Acme Commerce (contract expiring 2027-01-31) and need to confirm the SOC 2 re-attestation path and a couple of scope/technical asks that could affect term language. Specifically:  

- Auditor wants a refreshed evidence bundle covering 2026 activity (auth logs, audit logs, change management tickets) by Jan 15, 2027.
- We need a temporary log retention extension to 18 months (currently 12) for scoped systems for the audit period.
- We anticipate a product uplift: a new feature will drive a 2x traffic spike in Dec-Jan and we want to reserve burst/dedicated capacity during the audit window.

I attached the auditor’s evidence matrix. Can you confirm: 
1) A proposed evidence handoff cadence and format?
2) Whether Redwood can provide the 18-month retention carveout and estimated cost?
3) How we should reflect any capacity reservation in the renewal amendment / SOW?

Thanks — appreciate a quick outline so I can align procurement and the external auditor.

Best,
Javier
Javier Morales
Security Lead, Acme Commerce
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Javier Morales <javier.morales@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention change request

Hi Javier — thanks for the matrix and the heads-up. High level plan from Redwood: 

1) Evidence handoff cadence: weekly batches (CSV + gzipped logs) for auth and audit logs, plus a final consolidated package two weeks before Jan 15. We’ll provide a template CSV mapping (see attached redwood-evidence-instructions.pdf) and a Google Drive folder for secure upload.

2) Retention: we can support a scoped 18-month retention for the audit window. That will require a data-retention amendment (one-off uplift on storage + indexing) — estimate and billing note below.

3) Capacity: we can reserve a burst pool (Dedicated capacity) for Dec 15 — Feb 15 with a guaranteed throughput floor and additional burst units. We’ll include a clause in the amendment that defines the reserved baseline and metered overage.

Next steps I propose:  
- Quick sync tomorrow to walk through the evidence template and attachments.
- Aditya will produce a capacity estimate and recommended config.
- Laura will draft the short amendment language for retention and reserved capacity.

Availability: I can do a 30m call Thu 11/12 at 11am PT or Fri 11/13 at 9am PT — which works on your end?

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-evidence-instructions.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Javier Morales <javier.morales@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention change request

Thanks — quick technical notes from infra/solutions: 

- Evidence format: we accept newline-delimited JSON for events (preferred) or CSV with the attached mapping. Please include ISO-8601 timestamps and a correlation_id. MD5 checksums for batches help the auditor’s intake.

- Retention: for an 18-month carveout we’ll create a retention policy tag on the relevant log buckets; cost model is storage + retrieval indexing. Estimated uplift for the scoped systems in your matrix: $2,700/month (storage + index) during the extended window. I put a trimmed estimate in capacity_uplift_estimate.csv.

- Dedicated capacity: to cover a 2x spike with headroom and a reserved baseline we recommend adding one extra rtx-dedicated cluster with autoscaling floor of 50 RPS and burst to 200 RPS. One-month reserved (Dec-Jan) pricing is $18,000 for the baseline plus metered token overage. We will coordinate deployment to the same region to avoid cross-region egress.

I can join the proposed sync to walk through the technical handoff.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Javier Morales <javier.morales@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention change request

Javier / Procurement — drafting note from legal/compliance on the amendment text: 

- Term: align the amendment to the renewal term so retention uplift runs through 2027-03-31 (covers the audit lookback).
- Pricing: one-off monthly uplift for retention (as Aditya noted) plus reserved capacity fee for the Dec–Feb window; metered overage billed monthly.
- SLAs: add a preservation clause guaranteeing log exports within 24 hours of a request during the audit window and an evidence access point (read-only Drive link) with read access audit logs.

I’ll prepare a short SOW + amendment and generate a DocuSign packet. Expect a draft by Monday 11/16 EOD. If you need legal redlines earlier, send them back in-line.

Laura Bennett
Compliance & Contracts, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Javier Morales <javier.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention change request

Kimberly / Laura — thanks, this looks good. We’re aligned on the proposed cadence and the retention window. A few quick confirmations: 

- Cost: Acme procurement has budget for the $18,000 reserved fee + the retention uplift (budget code: ACM-IT-2027-RENEW). Please include the line items separately in the SOW.
- DocuSign: please send the packet when available and we’ll aim to return signed within 48 hours.
- Kickoff: Thu 11/19 10am PT works for the evidence intake & tech handoff. I’ll invite our external auditor to the call.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to the kickoff.

Javier
Javier Morales
Security Lead, Acme Commerce
